full_page.content:
1932, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 60 Cont.
Aug. 11 Mrs. M. Brenna, neighbor of above - 50 - cancer of womb ... fears operation .... promises more frequent Communion etc.
Page 61
Mrs. M. Ruane - 31 - T.B. n.c. wants a miracle Blank Page
Page 62
Aug . Mrs. Anna Furley - 56 - Toledo - blind - fell last Oct, and since not well ... Hopes to see shortly.
Chas. D. Hoban - in H. Kiefer - T.B.
Mrs. M. Krausman .. Hopeless ... Confinement: Mrs. Marie Krausman -43 - confined in Providence Hospital. Dr. wanted to remove her to Harper Hosp. for operation not allowed in Catholic hospitals .... He assured (tried to) husband that she would be dead before morning if not operated on - unconscious for three days. Fr. S. gave her the blessing " ... in periculis partus". and she is O.K. since. every- one surprised.
Mrs. Vera Kauffmann Austin. -
Mrs. Lottmer - 68 - nervous, etc. Miss Jennie Parker - non c. - a groth on face Arline Gibson - 3 mo. - spinal trouble Mrs. Mary Alleman - 32 - Asthma
Mrs. Adda Sarbeck non Cath. - 60 - ugly tumor
Bazil Lockwood - 35 - Saginaw - now in Ford Hospital for observation operation wanted to be averted.
Mrs. Cecelia Frost - 36 - bleeding breast - Fears cancer John A. Lamb about 65 - cancer of tongue Le Croix Fam. - means to save home Joseph Cor. 40 - dying in Pontiac Hospital - Wife & two little Children
Helen Smialek - 52 - Trained nurse no work
